meta.title: DSH Launcher
meta.description: Add games, download versions, install instances and manage content in DSH, with multiple game sources and custom adapters.

ui.title: DSH Launcher
ui.entry.label: Launch
ui.footer.hint: The panel syncs state every 1.5 seconds; every action reports its result.
ui.games.title: Games
ui.games.emptyHint: Add a game first, then open it to download versions, install instances and manage content.
ui.detail.versionsHint: Pick a version to create an instance of this game.
ui.detail.versionsEmpty: No versions available for this game
ui.detail.name: Instance name
ui.detail.optionsHint: These options are defined by the game adapter.
ui.detail.instancesHint: Instances of this game; launch, logs and folders live here.
ui.detail.noInstances: No instances yet. Download a version above first.
ui.detail.instanceSelect: Select an instance to manage its content
ui.detail.installedEmpty: This instance has no content yet
ui.instance.deleteHint: Deleting an instance removes its game files and content permanently.
ui.addGame.title: Add game
ui.addGame.subtitle: Bring in a game from code-hosting releases, a URL manifest, or an already installed local folder; save it, then open it to download versions.
ui.addGame.providerHint: Fill in the configuration for the chosen source type; test the connection before saving.
ui.addGame.label: Display name
ui.addGame.idPh: Leave empty to derive from the name
ui.addGame.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; used for instance folders and config files.
ui.addGame.repoHint: Release list and assets are read from this repository.
ui.addGame.argsPh: One argument per line, or space separated
ui.addGame.argsHint: Optional; quotes inside arguments are preserved.
ui.addGame.versionsHint: JSON array; every item needs at least id and url.
ui.addGame.pathHint: Points to an already installed game folder.
ui.addGame.testHint: Test once before saving to catch configuration problems early.
ui.addGame.needSource: Please enter a manifest URL or a static version list
ui.addGame.needExecutable: Please enter the executable file (for example game.exe)
ui.addGame.invalidVersions: The static version list must be a JSON array
ui.addGame.addedEmpty: No games added from the panel yet
ui.addGame.addedHint: Games provided by built-in and external adapters cannot be deleted here.
ui.addGame.deleteHint: Only the game definition is deleted; installed instances are kept.
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.dataRootHint: Configuration, game definitions and instances live here (read-only).
ui.settings.concurrencyHint: Simultaneous downloads, 1–32; lower it on slow networks.
ui.settings.invalidConcurrency: Download concurrency must be an integer between 1 and 32
ui.settings.invalidRetries: Retries must be an integer between 0 and 10
ui.sublauncher.title: Sub-launchers
ui.sublauncher.subtitle: Sub-launchers are separate projects; this launcher core contains no games. After installing from a GitHub Release or a zip URL, games appear automatically on the Games page.
ui.sublauncher.installHint: Supports GitHub repositories, zip URLs and local files; games appear automatically on the Games page after installation.
ui.sublauncher.repoHint: The repository release must contain a zip asset.
ui.sublauncher.urlHint: Direct download URL of the zip package.
ui.sublauncher.fileHint: Path of a local zip package.
ui.sublauncher.assetPatternHint: Picks a zip asset from the release; the first zip is used when empty.
ui.sublauncher.needSource: Please enter a repository, zip URL or local file path
ui.sublauncher.empty: No sub-launchers installed yet. Install one from a GitHub repository or zip URL (for example the official sub-launcher project of a game).
ui.sublauncher.deleteHint: Its games disappear from the Games page; installed instance files are kept.
ui.catalog.title: Recommended catalog
ui.catalog.hint: Install sub-launchers from the recommended catalog; games appear on the Games page once installed.
ui.catalog.empty: No sub-launchers in the catalog yet
ui.catalog.emptyHint: You can still install manually with the form below.
ui.catalog.needSource: This entry has no install source; please enter a repository or URL manually.
ui.catalog.manualHint: If the catalog fails to load or is empty, you can still install with a repository / URL / local file below.
